Residing in accommodation allotted to a relative.HRA not admissible if the employee resides in accommodation allotted to his/her parents, son I daughter by the Central/ State Government, Autonomous Bodies, Public Sector Undertaking or semi-Government Organization, e.g., Municipality, Port Trust, Nationalized Bank, LIC, etc. - Para. 5.1 (ii).
